arguments.content: Despite recent advances in federated and distributed machine learning, there remains a significant gap in methodologies that effectively address robustness and scalability simultaneously across heterogeneous client environments. Current approaches typically optimize for either performance or efficiency but rarely handle the combined challenges of noisy, incomplete data and diverse resource capabilities. Our proposed research aims to fill this gap by developing integrated algorithms and evaluation frameworks that can adapt dynamically to these real-world constraints.
